description: This is a C source file implementing a watchdog timer driver for Atmel SAM microcontrollers within the Zephyr RTOS framework. It includes functions for configuring, enabling, disabling, and feeding the watchdog, as well as handling interrupts and timeouts.

methods.name: wdt_sam_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for the watchdog timer, clears status and invokes callback.

methods.name: wdt_sam_convert_timeout
methods.description: Calculates watchdog counter value based on timeout and clock frequency.

methods.name: wdt_sam_disable
methods.description: Disables the watchdog timer if not already mode-set.

methods.name: wdt_sam_setup
methods.description: Configures the watchdog timer with options such as pause in sleep or halt by debug.

methods.name: wdt_sam_install_timeout
methods.description: Installs a timeout configuration for the watchdog, setting mode and callback.

methods.name: wdt_sam_feed
methods.description: Feeds (restarts) the watchdog timer to prevent timeout.

methods.name: wdt_sam_irq_config
methods.description: Configures the interrupt for the watchdog timer.

methods.name: wdt_sam_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog driver, disables at boot if configured, and sets up IRQ.
